summary: Start listening with Node net.Server timing and overload semantics.

target.notes: Returns the same Server; successful bind completion is asynchronous and reported by callback/listening event; bind errors preserve Node behavior.

semantics.notes: Returns the same Server; successful bind completion is asynchronous and reported by callback/listening event; bind errors preserve Node behavior.
